expiredJobs.title: React Developer
expiredJobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced React Developer to join our dynamic team in Pune. The ideal candidate should have 5-8 years of experience in developing scalable and high-performance web applications using React.js, Redux, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies. You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and product managers to build intuitive and engaging user experiences.
expiredJobs.responsibilities:
Develop, test, and maintain scalable React.js applications.

Work with Redux or React Context API for state management.

Implement responsive and pixel-perfect UI components based on Figma/Adobe XD designs.

Optimize components for maximum performance and scalability.

Integrate RESTful APIs and work with backend teams for seamless data flow.

Write clean, modular, and reusable code following best practices.

Work with React Hooks, Functional Components, and Custom Hooks for efficient development.

Collaborate with the QA team to ensure proper testing and bug fixes.

Stay updated with the latest React and frontend technologies.

Participate in code reviews, mentoring junior developers, and knowledge sharing sessions.

experience.description: Lead the development of a high-traffic web application using React and Redux. Collaborated with designers and backend teams to implement new features and optimize performance.
Built interactive user interfaces and maintained front-end code for multiple client projects. Improved load times by optimizing assets and using best practices in React.
